nodes.label: Anonymous Driver Placeholder Image
nodes.description: Grayscale cut-out (transparent background) of a racing driver in full-face helmet with dark visor and race suit, arms crossed. Generic, faceless driver portrait.
nodes.rationale: Used as a fallback/default driver photo in the race overlay when no pilot photo is provided; helmet and dark visor keep identity anonymous and grayscale tones fit any team color palette.

nodes.rationale: No data provider: teams, squad, staff, crests, score and clock are entered manually and stored in football-data.json.

nodes.label: Launcher / Installer (launcher/)
nodes.rationale: The .exe is only a launcher; module code lives on the server so modules can be updated without redistributing the .exe.

nodes.label: License Login & Session Token
nodes.rationale: Downloads require a license session; suspended/expired licenses or licenses not including a module are refused.

nodes.label: MODULE_CATALOG (backend/src/licensePlans.js)
nodes.rationale: New modules are registered server-side in the web project; until a version is published the client shows them as 'Próximamente'.

nodes.label: npm run module:pack / module:publish
nodes.rationale: Detects modified modules via Git, builds ZIPs and publishes with admin credentials from .env (OVERLAY_ADMIN_USER/PASSWORD).

nodes.label: NSIS Installer (npm run dist, electron-builder)
nodes.rationale: NSIS chosen over portable .exe because portable extraction to temp on every run triggers antivirus suspicion; asInvoker per-user install, bundles scraper Chromium so it works without Node/Chrome/Edge.

nodes.label: Streaming Module (reserved, no manifest yet)
nodes.rationale: Placeholder directory; once module.json, main.cjs, vite.config.js and sources are added the unified packaging flow picks it up automatically.

nodes.label: Ed25519 Package Signing (RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY / release-public-key.pem)
nodes.rationale: Server signs each package with a private key and the launcher ships the public key; packages without a valid signature are never executed.

nodes.label: launcherApi Version Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Shared libraries (express, socket.io, puppeteer, xlsx, Chromium) ship in the launcher; a module needing a new library declares a higher launcherApi so old launchers ask the user to update.

nodes.label: Module Contract: module.json + main.cjs start(ctx)
nodes.rationale: Every module is a package with module.json (id, version) and main.cjs exporting start(ctx), required by the launcher after extraction.

nodes.label: Optional Module Updates
nodes.rationale: Updates are never forced ('Actualizar y abrir' / 'Abrir sin actualizar') so the installed version works offline; only the first install requires download.

nodes.label: Windows SmartScreen & Code Signing (CSC_LINK, EV/OV certs)
nodes.norm_label: windows smartscreen & code signing (csc_link, ev/ov certs)
nodes.rationale: SmartScreen warns on any unsigned exe; only a code-signing certificate removes it (EV immediately, OV after reputation accrues).

nodes.label: Git-based Module Change Detector
nodes.rationale: Uses local Git changes inside each directory and only considers directories with module.json.
